svg.title: Component · Holdings pill · here.attention
svg.desc: Mirrors HoldingsPillBody + StatusGlyphView (App/HoldingsPill.swift, plan §16 — signed off 2026-09-26 on the canvas "Holdings Pill States", revision 2.1). Reads: On this device · Needs attention. The moment: a failed upload or sync, a conflict. Green = on this device; grey = on PicPlace, not here; slashed = nowhere reachable; one cloud, never green — ✓ PicPlace holds everything the project has, ↑ something here isn't up yet, amber while moving or checking, red for attention. Measured from the 16 Pro's own render (LL_PILL_SHEET=1).
